identity.description: An attacker uses command-line tools to discover network services on a Windows endpoint. Cortex should detect the execution of net.exe, nbtstat.exe, and other discovery utilities. The behavioral ABIOC detects anomalous process execution patterns associated with service discovery.

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of net.exe to enumerate network resources
Execution of nbtstat.exe to query NetBIOS names

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual Network Service Discovery Process Execution
biocs.description: Detection of net.exe, nbtstat.exe, or netstat.exe execution from unexpected locations or with unusual arguments
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('net.exe', 'nbtstat.exe', 'netstat.exe')
| filter actor_process_image_name not in ('explorer.exe', 'cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe')

abiocs.name: Suspicious Service Discovery Command-Line Behavior
abiocs.description: Detection of process execution with service discovery commands in an unexpected context
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('net.exe', 'nbtstat.exe', 'netstat.exe')
| filter actor_process_image_name not in ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'explorer.exe')

xql_queries.name: Detect Network Discovery Tools
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('net.exe', 'nbtstat.exe', 'netstat.exe')
| filter actor_process_image_name not in ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'explorer.exe')
| comp count() by action_process_image_name, actor_process_image_name
